  THURSDAY, JANUARY 18, 2024
  2800 N. STUDEBAKER ROAD
  DR. THOMAS J. CLARK COMMUNITY CENTER
  BRIDGE ROOM, 9:00 AM

Robert Livingstone, Chair  Sharleen Higa, Commissioner
Susan Redfield, Vice Chair  Kasey Schoen, Commissioner
Christopher Chavez, Commissioner  Silissa Uriarte Smith, Commissioner

Brent Dennis, Director
Jennifer Roberts, Executive Assistant

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL PUBLIC COMMENTS TO
  JENNIFER.ROBERTS@LONGBEACH.GOV

 CALL TO ORDER

 ROLL CALL

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 PRESENTATIONS

 Employee of the Month – December 2023

 State of the City: Service Heroes

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-51782  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Parks and Recreation
  Commission meeting of Thursday, December 21, 2023.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  24-51783  Recommendation to consider approval, or denial, of the fee waiver requests
  outlined in Attachment “A” in accordance with the Fee Waiver policy.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  24-51784  Recommendation to authorize the Director of Parks, Recreation and Marine to
  execute Personal Service Agreements with Delilah Jolyn Real to provide free and
  low-cost public cultural arts programs at the Department of Parks, Recreation and
  Marine facilities, from January 18, 2024 to August 31, 2024. (Citywide)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  24-51785  Recommendation to approve the placement location of memorial or
  commemorative bench at Martin Luther King Jr. Park, outlined in Attachment A.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Parks and Recreation Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker
is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Jennifer Roberts, Executive Assistant, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, or if you need the agenda provided in an alternate format, please call
Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101 by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.

If written language translation of the Commission agenda and minutes for non-English speaking
